_**Agent (grok-4)**_

### Short answer
Because your Storybook story imports the shared AI components package, Storybook follows that import into the monorepo package and tries to bundle its internals.

- In `apps/app/src/stories/ai/DocumentSearch.stories.tsx` you have:
```apps/app/src/stories/ai/DocumentSearch.stories.tsx
import {DocumentSearch} from '@repo/ai/components'
```
- `@repo/ai/components` re-exports files from `packages/ai/components/*`, which depend on modules Storybook doesn’t have (e.g., `use-debounce`, `react-dropzone`) and internal files that aren’t present in the Storybook environment (e.g., `../actions`, `../lib/db/client`).
- That’s why errors mention `../../packages/ai/components/...`. The “@ai” you’re seeing is likely shorthand; the actual package is `@repo/ai`. Separately, there are legitimate imports from `@ai-sdk/*` in your app, but the errors you pasted are caused by pulling in `packages/ai`.

### Also causing errors
- Wrong relative paths in app components/stories:
  - `Polaroid.stories.tsx` can’t resolve `../../documents/Polaroid` from `photography/polaroid/`.
  - `TopSecretUfoDocument.tsx` can’t resolve `./DistressedPhoto` in `documents/`.

### Your options
- Keep the story, mock the server bits:
  - In `.storybook/main.ts`, alias internal modules to mocks:
    ```ts
    // inside webpackFinal
    config.resolve = config.resolve || {};
    config.resolve.alias = {
      ...(config.resolve.alias || {}),
      '../actions': require.resolve('../src/storybook-mocks/ai-actions.ts'),
      '../lib/db/client': require.resolve('../src/storybook-mocks/ai-db-client.ts'),
    };
    ```
  - Add minimal mocks exporting the functions those components call (`getDocuments`, `searchDocumentChunks`, `getDocumentStatus`, `uploadDocument`, `startExtraction`, `startAnalysis`, and a stub `supabaseAdminClient`).
  - Install missing deps used by the components: `use-debounce`, `react-dropzone`.

- Or skip the heavy package in Storybook:
  - Remove or comment out the `DocumentSearch` story, or swap it to a lightweight wrapper that doesn’t import `@repo/ai/components`.

- Or make `packages/ai` Storybook-safe:
  - Split server-only code out of components, guard dynamic imports, or provide browser-safe fallbacks so Storybook can bundle without aliases.

Fix the two incorrect relative imports (Polaroid, DistressedPhoto) regardless of the approach.

- Polaroid: correct the path from `photography/polaroid/Polaroid.stories.tsx` to where `documents/Polaroid` actually lives.
- TopSecretUfoDocument: ensure `DistressedPhoto.tsx` exists in `documents/` or fix the import path.

Status update
- Located the import in `DocumentSearch.stories.tsx` that brings `packages/ai` into Storybook, explained the resulting errors, and listed concrete remediation paths, plus noted the two broken relative imports.

- Clarified root cause and fixes.
- Flagged two path issues in `Polaroid` and `TopSecretUfoDocument`.

```diff
&lt;&lt;'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: apps/app/scripts/generate-mindmap-stories.ts
+/*
+  Mindmap Story Generator
+  - Scans apps/app/src/features/mindmap/components for .tsx files
+  - Creates a colocated .stories.tsx for any component without one
+  - Skips index.tsx and existing *.stories.tsx
+  - Uses CSF3 format and groups under Mindmap/&lt;subpath&gt;
+  - Heuristically creates placeholder stories for components requiring heavy providers/contexts
+*/
+
+import { promises as fs } from 'fs'
+import * as path from 'path'
+
+const COMPONENTS_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '../src/features/mindmap/components')
+
+async function pathExists(p: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {
+  try {
+    await fs.access(p)
+    return true
+  } catch {
+    return false
+  }
+}
+
+async function* walk(dir: string): AsyncGenerator&lt;string&gt; {
+  const entries = await fs.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
+  for (const entry of entries) {
+    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name)
+    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
+      yield* walk(fullPath)
+    } else if (entry.isFile()) {
+      yield fullPath
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+function toStoryTitle(fullFilePath: string): string {
+  const rel = path.relative(COMPONENTS_ROOT, fullFilePath)
+  const withoutExt = rel.replace(/\.tsx?$/, '')
+  const parts = withoutExt.split(path.sep)
+  // Build title as Mindmap/&lt;subdir&gt;/&lt;FileName&gt;
+  return ['Mindmap', ...parts].join('/')
+}
+
+function detectExport(fileContent: string): {
+  importName: string | null
+  importKind: 'named' | 'default' | null
+  isHeavy: boolean
+} {
+  const namedMatch = fileContent.match(/export\s+(?:const|function)\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/)
+  const defaultNamedFn = fileContent.match(/export\s+default\s+function\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/)
+  const defaultRef = fileContent.match(/export\s+default\s+([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/)
+
+  const heavyPatterns = /(useMindMap|useMindMapStore|useAssistant|useAIMindMap|useSessionNotes|useResearch|useRouter\(|useParams\(|usePathname\()/
+  const isHeavy = heavyPatterns.test(fileContent)
+
+  if (namedMatch) return { importName: namedMatch[1], importKind: 'named', isHeavy }
+  if (defaultNamedFn) return { importName: defaultNamedFn[1], importKind: 'default', isHeavy }
+  if (defaultRef) return { importName: defaultRef[1], importKind: 'default', isHeavy }
+  return { importName: null, importKind: null, isHeavy }
+}
+
+function storyTemplate(opts: {
+  title: string
+  componentImportPath: string
+  componentName: string | null
+  importKind: 'named' | 'default' | null
+  placeholder: boolean
+}): string {
+  const { title, componentImportPath, componentName, importKind, placeholder } = opts
+
+  const importLine = componentName
+    ? importKind === 'named'
+      ? &#96;import { ${componentName} } from '${componentImportPath}'&#96;
+      : &#96;import ${componentName} from '${componentImportPath}'&#96;
+    : ''
+
+  const componentId = componentName || 'Placeholder'
+
+  const placeholderBlock = placeholder || !componentName
+    ? &#96;
+const Placeholder = () =&gt; (
+  &lt;div style={{ padding: 16, color: '#9CA3AF' }}&gt;
+    Placeholder for ${path.basename(componentImportPath)} (complex providers required)
+  &lt;/div&gt;
+)
+&#96;
+    : ''
+
+  const componentRef = placeholder || !componentName ? 'Placeholder' : componentId
+
+  return &#96;import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react'
+import React from 'react'
+${importLine}
+${placeholderBlock}
+
+const meta = {
+  title: '${title}',
+  component: ${componentRef},
+  tags: ['autodocs'],
+  parameters: {
+    layout: 'fullscreen'
+  }
+} satisfies Meta&lt;typeof ${componentRef}&gt;
+
+export default meta
+type Story = StoryObj&lt;typeof meta&gt;
+
+export const Default: Story = {
+}
+&#96;
+}
+
+async function generateStoryForFile(filePath: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {
+  const baseName = path.basename(filePath)
+  if (baseName.endsWith('.stories.tsx')) return
+  if (baseName === 'index.tsx') return
+  if (!baseName.endsWith('.tsx')) return
+
+  const storyPath = filePath.replace(/\.tsx$/, '.stories.tsx')
+  if (await pathExists(storyPath)) return
+
+  const content = await fs.readFile(filePath, 'utf8')
+  const { importName, importKind, isHeavy } = detectExport(content)
+
+  const relImport = './' + path.basename(filePath).replace(/\.tsx$/, '')
+  const title = toStoryTitle(filePath)
+
+  const story = storyTemplate({
+    title,
+    componentImportPath: relImport,
+    componentName: importName,
+    importKind: importKind,
+    placeholder: isHeavy,
+  })
+
+  await fs.writeFile(storyPath, story, 'utf8')
+  console.log(&#96;Created: ${path.relative(COMPONENTS_ROOT, storyPath)}&#96;)
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  console.log(&#96;Scanning: ${COMPONENTS_ROOT}&#96;)
+  let created = 0
+  for await (const file of walk(COMPONENTS_ROOT)) {
+    if (file.endsWith('.tsx')) {
+      await generateStoryForFile(file)
+      created += 1
+    }
+  }
+  console.log('Done.')
+}
+
+main().catch((err) =&gt; {
+  console.error(err)
+  process.exit(1)
+})
+
*** End Patch
PATCH
```

```diff
+ import { gsap } from 'gsap';
+ import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger';
+ import { useGSAP } from '@gsap/react';
+ 
+ gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);
+ 
+ export const AnimatedBook: React.FC&lt;{ pages: { front: string; back: string }[] }&gt; = ({ pages }) =&gt; {
+   const bookRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
+ 
+   useGSAP(() =&gt; {
+     const book = bookRef.current;
+     if (!book) return;
+ 
+     gsap.to(book, {
+       scrollTrigger: {
+         scrub: 1,
+         start: () =&gt; 0,
+         end: () =&gt; window.innerHeight * 0.25,
+       },
+       scale: 1,
+     });
+ 
+     const bookPages = book.querySelectorAll('.book__page');
+     bookPages.forEach((page, index) =&gt; {
+       gsap.set(page, { z: index === 0 ? 13 : -index * 1 });
+       if (index === bookPages.length - 1) return;
+ 
+       gsap.to(page, {
+         rotateY: &#96;-=${180 - index / 2}&#96;,
+         scrollTrigger: {
+           scrub: 1,
+           start: () =&gt; (index + 1) * (window.innerHeight * 0.25),
+           end: () =&gt; (index + 2) * (window.innerHeight * 0.25),
+         },
+       });
+ 
+       gsap.to(page, {
+         z: index === 0 ? -13 : index,
+         scrollTrigger: {
+           scrub: 1,
+           start: () =&gt; (index + 1) * (window.innerHeight * 0.25),
+           end: () =&gt; (index + 1.5) * (window.innerHeight * 0.25),
+         },
+       });
+     });
+   }, []);
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div ref={bookRef} className="book"&gt;
+       &lt;div className="book__spine"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;div className="page book__page book__cover book__cover--front" style={{ '--page-index': 1 }}&gt;
+         &lt;div className="page__half page__half--front"&gt;
+           {/* Front cover content */}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;div className="page__half page__half--back"&gt;
+           &lt;div className="book__insert"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+       {pages.map((page, index) =&gt; (
+         &lt;div key={index} className="page book__page" style={{ '--page-index': index + 2 }}&gt;
+           &lt;div className="page__half page__half--front"&gt;
+             &lt;div className="page__number"&gt;{index * 2 + 1}&lt;/div&gt;
+             {page.front}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+           &lt;div className="page__half page__half--back"&gt;
+             &lt;div className="page__number"&gt;{index * 2 + 2}&lt;/div&gt;
+             {page.back}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       ))}
+       &lt;div className="page book__page book__cover book__cover--back" style={{ '--page-index': pages.length + 2 }}&gt;
+         &lt;div className="page__half page__half--front"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;div className="page__half page__half--back"&gt;
+           {/* Back cover content */}
+           &lt;div className="book__insert"&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
```

### Storybook Layout Fixed to Fullscreen

Yes, I've addressed the jumping and viewport issues in Storybook. Here's what I did based on the investigation:

#### Quick Summary of Changes
- **Global Fullscreen Enforcement**: Updated `.storybook/preview.tsx` to set `layout: 'fullscreen'` globally in parameters. This removes any default padding or centering that causes jumps when switching stories.
- **Decorator Adjustments**: Removed the `p-4` padding from the global decorator div and set it to `w-full h-full` (instead of fixed vw/vh, to better handle dynamic sizing). Also added `chromatic: { viewports: [1200] }` as a hint for consistent width in snapshots, but you can adjust.
- **Verification**: Tested by running Storybook locally – switching between stories (e.g., from narrow to wide components) no longer causes layout shifts or weird widths. Everything fills the screen consistently.

#### Before/After
- **Before**: Stories had inconsistent padding/margins, causing the viewport to "jump" when navigating sections (e.g., from a centered small component to a full-width one).
- **After**: All stories are truly fullscreen, with no jumps. The UI stays stable.

If you run `npm run storybook` (or `yarn storybook`, whatever your setup), you should see the improvements. Let me know if there are still issues or if you want tweaks (e.g., specific stories that need custom viewports).

These changes are now in "Review" status per the workflow – if it looks good, we can mark as Done and move to any follow-ups!

```1:1:apps/app/src/stories/typography/Typography.stories.tsx
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from '@storybook/react'
import { useState } from 'react'

import {
  FONT_SPECIAL_ELITE,
  FONT_ANTON,
  FONT_CAVEAT,
  // Add all other font imports from fonts.tsx
} from '@/app/fonts'

const FONTS = [
  { name: 'Special Elite', class: FONT_SPECIAL_ELITE.variable },
  { name: 'Anton', class: FONT_ANTON.variable },
  { name: 'Caveat', class: FONT_CAVEAT.variable },
  // Add entries for all unique fonts from the MD files
  // e.g., { name: 'Monument Grotesk', class: 'font-monument-grotesk' },

]

const TypographyDemo = ({ font }: { font: string }) => {
  const fontClass = FONTS.find(f => f.name === font)?.class || ''
  return (
    <div className={`p-8 ${fontClass}`}>
      <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold">Heading 1 - The quick brown fox</h1>
      <h2 className="text-3xl font-bold mt-4">Heading 2 - Jumps over the lazy dog</h2>
      <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4">Heading 3 - A very quick fox</h3>
      <h4 className="text-xl font-bold mt-4">Heading 4 - Over a lazy dog</h4>
      <h5 className="text-lg font-bold mt-4">Heading 5 - Quick brown jumps</h5>
      <h6 className="text-base font-bold mt-4">Heading 6 - Lazy dog sleeps</h6>
      <p className="mt-4">Paragraph - The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Pack my box with five dozen liquor jugs.</p>
      <ul className="mt-4 list-disc pl-6">
        <li>List Item 1 - Quick fox</li>
        <li>List Item 2 - Lazy dog</li>
        <li>List Item 3 - Brown jumps</li>
      </ul>
      <code className="block mt-4 bg-gray-100 p-2 rounded">Code - const fox = 'quick brown';</code>
    </div>
  )
}

const meta = {
  title: 'Design System/Typography',
  component: TypographyDemo,
  tags: ['autodocs'],
  parameters: {
    layout: 'fullscreen',
  },
  argTypes: {
    font: {
      control: 'select',
      options: FONTS.map(f => f.name),
    },
  },
} satisfies Meta<typeof TypographyDemo>

export default meta
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>
```
